title: Deborah Leads with Courage
summary: In Deborah Leads with Courage, kids slow down long enough to see the choice, pressure, or promise inside the passage. God can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right. Deborah led with wisdom, and Barak learned to act with courage.

read_it.prompt: Read Judges 4:1-16 and underline the part that best shows leadership.

tell_it: Deborah served as a judge in Israel. She helped Barak obey God's command and led with faith. Kids can retell it by naming what happened, who responded, and what God showed.
understand_it: God can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right. Deborah Leads with Courage gives children a way to connect the Bible event to choices they actually face.
age_5_7_explanation: Deborah led with wisdom, and Barak learned to act with courage.
age_8_11_explanation: God can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right. The lesson helps older kids compare the story's wise path with the easier path people may have wanted.
teen_explanation: When a group needs someone wise to speak up, Deborah shows that God can use steady leaders to help others obey. God can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right. The story leaves room to talk about courage, humility, repentance, or hope without pretending the hard part is small.
key_truths: God can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right.
Deborah Leads with Courage shows leadership through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When a group needs someone wise to speak up, Deborah shows that God can use steady leaders to help others obey.
life_application: When a group needs someone wise to speak up, Deborah shows that God can use steady leaders to help others obey.

activity.title: Wise Leader Seat
activity.instructions: Take turns sitting in a leader chair and giving one wise, God-honoring choice for a hard moment.

prayer_prompt: Jesus, help me remember the truth in Deborah Leads with Courage and live it with people around me.
